verdict.rationale: Supabase's own branching creates isolated preview environments per pull request for testing configuration, schema, and feature changes before merging (review). Its MCP exposes migration tools (list_migrations/apply_migration) and branch merge/reset/rebase (versioning). Daily backups and PITR offer database-level restore (rollback). However, none of this is documented as versioning or rolling back automations specifically (Cron jobs, Database Webhooks, Edge Functions); applying it to them is implied rather than shown, and community users call the migration workflow a weakness. Missing for 10: explicit version history for Cron jobs, webhooks, and Edge Functions; a documented automation-level rollback (rather than whole-database PITR); non-experimental MCP branching; independent hands-on corroboration.
